The film was a critical and commercial failure, winning five Golden Raspberry Awards, including Worst Picture, tying with "Howard the Duck".

Erotic thriller "Color of Night" became the only Golden Raspberry Worst Picture "winner" to not receive a single other Razzie (out of eight other nominations). " Thumbelina" became the first animated film to be nominated for and win a Razzie, which it received for Worst Original Song. " The Specialist", "Wyatt Earp", "The Flintstones" and "" each took home two awards, even though the latter two weren't nominated for Worst Picture. 13th Golden Raspberry Awards | The 13th Golden Raspberry Awards were held on March 28, 1993, at the Hollywood Roosevelt Hotel to recognize the worst the movie industry had to offer in 1992. Just like Bill Cosby, Tom Selleck do not attend his award and later accepted it on "The Chevy Chase Show".
